title: Playing with Buddy Petit: head arrangements, style, cutting contests
summary: Petit led a seven-piece head-arranging band, played close to Armstrong, was powerful, and met Rena in wagon contests.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
